next_cycle_soh.target: next recorded discharge relative SOH percent
next_cycle_soh.cross_battery_comparator: LOBO MAE 0.5924 SOH percentage points; persistence MAE 0.5574

rul.target: remaining recorded discharges until first capacity <= 1.4 Ah
rul.cross_battery_comparator: Exploratory three-cell LOBO; XGBoost pooled MAE 11.67 cycles across three held-out complete cells

provenance: NASA PCoE accelerated-aging laboratory cells B0005, B0006, B0007 and B0018.
limitations: Final inference artifacts are fitted on the available eligible cells; validation metrics come only from held-out-cell evaluation and are not these artifacts' out-of-sample performance.
Only four cells are available and only three cross the 1.4 Ah RUL threshold.
B0007 is right-censored; it is excluded from RUL training rather than assigned an invented failure time.
This dataset does not establish vehicle-pack performance or second-life safety.

second_life_screen.disclaimer: Project screening assumptions, not universal industry cutoffs, certification criteria, or a safety determination.
